topic: Try the Slack connector against a real workspace once it runs
detail: SP-061 is tested only against a fake Slack Web API shaped after Slack's documented responses (auth.test, conversations.list, .info, .history, .replies, cursor paging, 429 Retry-After); no session contacts Slack or handles a real token. Unverified assumption: real responses match. Once the connector runs (RC-1650), the user writes a user token with the channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history, channels:read, groups:read, im:read and mpim:read scopes to <profile>/token (mode 0600, the folder mode 0700) themselves, allowlists one channel, and checks that one sync stores it under slack://<team>/<channel>/... in the expected space.
